tagline: Leading supplier of semiconductor test automation, inspection and metrology solutions optimizing manufacturing yield and productivity
hero_kpi_rationale: Cohu's future success depends on its ability to enhance existing products and develop new products with improved performance capabilities. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D to capitalize on high-growth opportunities in HBM inspection, AI-driven test solutions, and wide bandgap semiconductors.

ai_positioning.summary: Cohu identifies AI as a key growth opportunity. The company focuses on high-performance processor test in AI applications (CPUs, embedded-NPUs, discrete and integrated GPUs, ASICs and xPUs) and is developing AI-driven software analytics to optimize semiconductor manufacturing yield and productivity.
